title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery — Waiver Requests Signed by the Debtor
content:
## Situation of use and capability

A waiver request on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** is signed by the debtor and goes in with the debtor's Financial Status Report attached; the amount it asks VA to waive is the part of the debt the debtor cannot be expected to repay from their own means.

The amount a waiver request asks VA to waive is fixed only after the debt's ledger carries the reinstatement deposit owed on any repayment plan of the debt that was cancelled for missed installments.

Put another way: where the debt has a repayment plan that was cancelled for missed installments, the amount asked is set only once the reinstatement deposit owed on that plan stands on the debt's ledger.

The submission tool records one waiver request on one debt, received today by phone and pending a decision by the Committee on Waivers and Compromises, together with whether a Financial Status Report is attached. The debt's balance and collection status are not changed by the call.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `submit_waiver_request_4f8614a0`. It belongs to the debtor: the representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves signs and submits the request during the call.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `debt_id` | The reference number of the VA debt the waiver is asked on, as shown on the debt record returned by the debt lookup for this debtor | Identifier text |
| `requested_amount` | The amount the debtor asks VA to waive, in USD | A positive number with 2 decimal places, stored rounded half-to-even to the cent; passed at cent precision |
| `fsr_submitted` | Whether a Financial Status Report accompanies the request | `true` when the debtor attaches a signed Financial Status Report to this request; `false` when the request goes in without one and the report is still to follow |
| `received_within_hold_window` | Whether today falls inside the debt's collection-hold window counted from its notice date | `true` when today is within that window, so the request is one that holds collection; `false` when today is after that window has closed |

## Return

A successful call returns `request_id` (reference number of the waiver request; its presence means the request is on file), `debt_id`, `request_kind` (always "waiver"), `received_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `requested_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `fsr_submitted` (boolean), `received_within_hold_window` (boolean) and `decision_outcome` (always "pending").

## Hypothetical illustration

A request for 1,500.00 USD with a report attached, made after the hold window has closed, returns a request reference with `request_kind` "waiver", `fsr_submitted` true, `received_within_hold_window` false and `decision_outcome` "pending".
